{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Select the group: NEW customers reached by PAID_SEARCH (all rows in this group)
new_paid_search = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (sales['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Check the size of this group
n_total = len(new_paid_search)
print(f"Total number of NEW customers reached by PAID_SEARCH: {n_total}")

# Now, count how many of them converted (converted == 1)
num_converted = new_paid_search['converted'].sum()
print(f"Number of converted orders in this group: {num_converted}")

# Compute the fraction
fraction_converted = num_converted / n_total
print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction_converted:.4f}")

# Also, check if there are any missing values in `converted` in this group
missing_converted = new_paid_search['converted'].isnull().sum()
print(f"Missing `converted` values in this group: {missing_converted}")"}
